description: Continuous Fair Offer certification for an x402 API: the full certification now (priced at 5 cents or less, your route is paid once to check that failed calls are free and receipts are signed), then re-run about once a day for 30 days. The public status and badge show the latest check, so a pass is withdrawn the day a check fails, and every check's signed result is published. One payment, no renewal; a seller pays for the checking, never for the outcome. Price: $1.00 in USDC per call, paid with x402 inside the tool call. Or send a Skyfire pay or kya-pay token in the kyapay-token header (or in this tool's kyapay-token argument), and this tool charges $1.00 to it. Failed calls aren't charged.

kyapay-token.description: A Skyfire pay or kya-pay token made for Agoranome's service, from a client that can't set the kyapay-token header. Leave it out when paying with x402 or the header.

notify.description: Optional https webhook, POSTed the day a check changes the verdict or finds drift
notify.title: Notify

url.description: Public https URL of your paid endpoint
